title: Settings
description: Your account, and how the app looks and behaves on this device.

transcript.heading: Transcript
transcript.preview: Round Robin లో ప్రతి process కి ఒక time quantum ఇస్తాం। यह exam के लिए important है।
transcript.autoScrollHint: When on, the live transcript scrolls to new text while you're at the bottom.
transcript.announce: Read new transcript lines aloud with a screen reader
transcript.announceHint: Announces each finished line on the live screen. Off by default to avoid interrupting.

language.heading: Languages
language.showLabels: Show language labels (EN, TE, HI) on transcript lines
language.showTransliteration: Show Telugu and Hindi lines in Latin script too
language.showTransliterationHint: Adds a romanised version under each Telugu or Hindi line.
language.filterHint: Hidden languages are collapsed, not deleted. At least one language stays visible.

deviceNote: The settings below are saved on this device only.
